[1/3] Plan: monthly word-recognition far check on its own schedule and store

impact_assessment.why: R7 requires far transfer measured separately; near-only measurement cannot detect (or honestly deny) far transfer, and the trial needs a far outcome
impact_assessment.benefits: untrained word memory probed monthly without contaminating practice metrics; honest by design since reviews say far transfer is usually absent
impact_assessment.mitigation: separate store/screen/schedule; seeded deterministic order; no effect on history, motivation or adaptive
